title: Bounded multiplication loop
statement: Fix a natural number $E$, an oracle on four indices and Boolean words, an input Boolean word $x$, and a register bound $B$. For every Boolean flag $f$, natural number $c$, and register state $st$ with $st.C=c$, $st.Z=0$, all eighteen register values at most $B$, and $st.T+c\,st.P\le B$, the machine has a finite run from the multiplication-loop state with registers $st$ to the multiplication-finish state with $C=0$ and $T=st.T+c\,st.P$. At every configuration strictly before the endpoint, the machine's validity conditions hold and all register values are at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: the oracle has four indices and takes Boolean words
every register of $st$ is at most $B$
